title: MIMI reference implementation v1
description: Rust reference implementation of IETF MIMI over MLS (RFC 9420) on OpenMLS (extensions-draft). Implements latest drafts as written: mimi-arch-03, mimi-protocol-06, mimi-content-09, mimi-room-policy-04, plus MLS deps normatively required by protocol-06: mls-extensions-10, barnes-mls-appsync-01, mls-ratchet-tree-options-01, mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-07. Out of scope for v1: identity, portability, attachments, mahy extras. Specs in /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs.
